notes.title: New Release - Guardians of Graxia
notes.notes:
Guardians of Graxia is now available on Steam!

The four powerful Guardians will guide your armies into battle in Guardians of Graxia - a card-based board game set in a floating island environment high in the sky of the Graxia world.

Enjoy 10% off until November 17th at 10am Pacific Time.
